metadata.title: Application Input and Request Handling

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for safely receiving, validating, and interpreting inputs to applications without ambiguity or manipulation.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Application request interfaces including web requests, API inputs, form submissions, and system-to-application calls.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for preventing malformed, ambiguous, or malicious inputs from altering intended application behavior.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Application input handling assumes baseline application identity, purpose, and ownership.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Request handling occurs after actor identity is established and before authorization decisions are enforced.

metadata.remarks: Application Input and Request Handling defines trust properties required to ensure applications correctly interpret requests. This pattern addresses malformed inputs, intent ambiguity, injection, and confused-deputy risks, without addressing authorization logic or session state.

components.title: Input Validation and Normalization
components.description: Validates and normalizes incoming input before it influences application logic.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Injection of malicious or malformed data into application input paths.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Input validation and constraint enforcement to reject unsafe data.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Integrity checks ensure request data conforms to expected formats.

components.title: Request Intent Disambiguation
components.description: Ensures the intended action of a request is explicit and unambiguous.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Crafting requests that exploit ambiguous interpretation paths.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Policy enforcement requiring explicit, well-scoped request intent.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Policies define how application requests must explicitly convey intent.

components.title: Confused-Deputy Prevention
components.description: Prevents applications from being tricked into misusing their own authority.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of trusted application authority through malicious input.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Context-aware authorization boundaries to prevent misuse.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Application enforces authorization based on request context, not just identity.

components.title: Request Handling Observability
components.description: Provides visibility into rejected, malformed, or suspicious requests.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Suppression of evidence related to malicious input attempts.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Audit logging of request validation and rejection decisions.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Application logs request handling and validation outcomes.
Audit review supports investigation of malicious or erroneous inputs.
